description: Edit an unsent draft: its subject, body, and To, Cc or Bcc recipients. Only what you pass changes, and each field you pass replaces the current one: `body` replaces the WHOLE body (in a reply or forward draft that includes the quoted original), and `to: []` clears the To line. `format: "markdown"` writes the new body formatted. To add or drop a Cc without retyping the rest, use `addCc` / `removeCc` instead of `cc`: the existing Cc stays. Nothing is sent; send it with outlook_send_draft. Messages that are not drafts are refused. The confirmation shows the draft as it is now, because the replaced text cannot be recovered. The result is checked against the draft Outlook returns. If Outlook does not answer in time, the connection drops, or a server error (5xx) comes back after the request was sent, the result has status "unknown": the write may well have gone through, so check before retrying — never resend blindly. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

addCc.description: Cc addresses to add, keeping the current Cc (not with `cc`)

bcc.description: New Bcc recipients; replaces the list ([] clears it)

body.description: New body; replaces the whole current body

cc.description: New Cc recipients; replaces the list ([] clears it)

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

format.description: How `body` is written: "text" (default), "markdown" (sent as formatted HTML) or "html". Only with `body`.

html.description: Same as format "html" (older spelling). Only with `body`.

id.description: Draft Id (from outlook_create_draft, outlook_reply draftOnly, or outlook_list_messages folder "drafts")

removeCc.description: Cc addresses to take off, keeping the rest (not with `cc`)

to.description: New To recipients; replaces the list ([] clears it)

name: outlook_update_draft
